subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Puerperium: involution, sepsis, breastfeeding and contraception timing

steps.tx: **Involution** (**6 weeks**, fundus umbilicus day 1 descending finger daily, **afterpains** multipara breastfeeding oxytocin, **lochia** rubra week serosa alba; subinvolution retained infection) with **vitals** (fever 38 twice excludes first 24 hours, tachycardia hypotension sepsis) watches; **bladder** (retention overflow, early catheter out) and **bowels** (constipation fibres) recover. Fundal massage boggy; retained explores.
steps.say: Finger daily umbilicus down 6 weeks is involution: afterpains nursing multipara. Boggy massages retained explores.

steps.tx: **Puerperal sepsis** (**endometritis** fever uterine tenderness foul lochia, **wound infection**, **mastitis**, **UTI**, **thrombophlebitis**; Group A strep toxic shock, **gentamicin with clindamycin** broad, cultures first) with **septic pelvic thrombophlebitis** (spiking despite antibiotics, heparin trial) and **necrotising fasciitis** (pain out of proportion, debride) emergencies; hand hygiene bundles prevent. Prolonged rupture sections risk.
steps.say: Tender foul fever uterus is endometritis: cultures gentamicin clindamycin. Spiking despite heparin trials.

steps.tx: **Breastfeeding** (**colostrum** days, mature week 2, **on demand 8 to 12 feeds**, **latch** asymmetric areola, **mastitis** wedge erythema fever **flucloxacillin** nursing continues, **abscess** drains nursing, **engorgement** cold cabbage) with **medicines** (most compatible, tetracyclines avoid, codeine banned, Hale checks) sustains; **cracked nipples** (latch corrects, lanolin) heal. HIV ART suppresses nurses.
steps.say: Wedge red fever breast nursing continues flucloxacillin is mastitis: latch corrects cracks. Abscess drains nurses.

steps.tx: **Contraception** (**LAM** exclusive under 6 months amenorrhoeic 98 percent, **IUCD** immediate postplacental, **progestin** breastfeeding safe, **combined after 6 months** nursing or 3 weeks non-nursing VTE, **sterilisation** minilap) with **postnatal visits** (day 3, weeks 1 to 2, 6 weeks; **depression screening** Edinburgh, anaemia iron, perineal physio) closes; **immunisation** (rubella nonimmune, anti-D) completes. interpregnancy 18 months counsels.
steps.say: Nursing amenorrhoeic exclusive 6 months is LAM 98: IUCD immediate progestin safe. Depression screened visits.
